From: Elena Torres <elena@openweave.dev>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T09:12:00Z
Subject: Sandbox hours voucher request — OpenWeave sprint

Hi Chloe,

Hope you are well — I'm Elena, one of the maintainers for OpenWeave. We're running a three-day contributor sprint at River City Hack Lab (June 28–30) and supporting ~25 new contributors who need access to GPU-backed sandboxes for light fine-tuning and evaluation.

We'd like to request a voucher for 600 sandbox GPU-hours to be used across three projects during the sprint window. The goals are onboarding, reproducible demos, and a short live checkpointing workshop. If possible we'd also like a one-week trial extension for two of our newer maintainers so they can finish ingestion scripts.

Quick details:
- Org: OpenWeave Collective
- Event: River City Hack Lab sprint (in-person)
- Requested: 600 sandbox GPU-hours + two 7-day trial extensions
- Use case: non-commercial contributor onboarding and small evals

We can provide a short one-page agenda and attendee list if needed. Please let me know what information you need to move this forward.

Thanks,
Elena
Maintainer, OpenWeave Collective
elena@openweave.dev

--

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and congrats on running the in-person sprint. This is the right kind of community activity for our program. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I route to approvals:

1) Do the 600 hours need to be reserved as a single voucher, or can we issue smaller per-project allocations (recommended for tracking)?
2) Who exactly are the two maintainers that need a 7-day trial extension (email addresses)?
3) Are there any compliance constraints (e.g., participant data residency or air-gapped requirements)?

If you can reply with the maintainer emails and whether you prefer a single voucher or split, I'll put this through our internal approval path (cc'ing Marcus).

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Developer Advocate, Redwood Inference
chloe@redwoodinference.com
